comment: Fun professor. Great class.
One of the best professors I've ever had, also one of the sassiest. Truly cares about his students. Test are difficult but if you study they're aren't impossible.

Dr. Case is very thorough in his teaching. He explains the concepts, demonstrates with sample problems, makes real-world connections, gives you in-class practice, and goes over the answers with the class. He really goes out of his way to make sure you understand the material, and is always willing to help. Made chemistry less painful! :D

Such a great professor. I am not a chem major, but after his class, I seriously considered it! He is very understanding and kind, and I learned a ton in his class. Highly recommended for majors and non-majors alike! One of my favorite profs at UR.
He is amazing. Very clear explanations. Slideshows are detailed. And classes are always fun. He even helped me with advising. Great guy! Definitely recommend.

Dr. Case is by far the best chem 141 prof at UR. He prepares you very well for Organic way better then the other professors. Homework,quizzes and lab are all great grade boosters. His3main tests final and midterm are hard but if you study an A is very realistic. Loves to have fun in class and brings food. Helps you whenever and gives partial credit

love dr. case! he is very fair and sweet! he gives out m&ms and cookies and donuts during breaks (he gives 5 min breaks in class) Overall, i really enjoyed being in class, and would highly recommend him to everyone! his final was harder tho...
Dr. Case is the best. My favorite teacher by far so far at UR. He's very clear but challenges you in a good way. Plus he's totes fabulous. My favorite part is when he accidentally curses in class.

I was so happy to see Mr Case teaching my section this semester that i had to fit his class in. He always makes the class interesting and enjoy it even better when he has his "back" towards the class. I would love to be his vampire Eric =)

Best teacher I have ever had...ever. He explains everything very clear and he sincerely cares about all of his students. His tests are very fair and he makes class enjoyable to a point where I look forward to seeing him.

Great lab professor.  Really helped my understanding in chemistry.  Very helpful in lab and understanding the concepts.  Explained them in easy to understand terms.  Hard assignments, but always willing to help you out.  Really nice professor.

Dr. Case is great! He really cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He explains concepts very well and understands not all of us are chem majors. I definitely recommend him...I love his class!
love his teaching style and hes there to help with assistance. would def take his class again real easy on the eyes

Dr. Case is an amazing professor! I really recommend him! He explains things very carefully and he is always available for office hours. Quizzes are not bad and he gives a lot of opportunities for extra credit. Take him! One of the best chem teachers Ive ever had.

Not the hardest but not the easiest professor. He explains things VERY well and wants all of his students to do well. He offers extra credit for attending every class for the semester and random extra credit on quizzes. The homework is online and also very helpful in terms of helping you understand the material.
Dr. Case is awesome, very easy to talk to and explains things succinctly and clearly. Also very flexible when it comes to homework and absences
dr. case is soo adorable, his quizzes are easy and powerpoints are easy to understand. the exams are harder than the quizzes but do-able. i love him! take dr. case!
He is fantastic!! And really cares about helping his students to understand the material

He is the nicest man I have ever met. He goes above and beyond for his students. He is very well organized for class and when you miss a class he prints you out a powerpoint. He is very efficient with grading and always offers review sessions and extra office hours. TAKE HIM! Besides being such an amazing teacher he is funny and adorable! I <3 Him!
I would probably marry Dr. Case. He is so cute. But besides that, he's very helpful, clear, and very easy to get to know. Take his class!!
he is so adorable i love him!!! he is funny and and so helpful!
Very nice person and extremely helpful in and out of lab.  He is funny and easiy to get to know on a personal level.  Take him if you can

Greatest teacher ever! Dr. Case is so funny, interesting, and helpful that you want to go to chem lab and do everything correctly! I would strongly recommend his class to anyone! I've taken two semesters of lab with him already, and I'm taking another!
